headerDisplay: Exposes ambient CO2/air-quality and room temperature from a Withings WS-50 scale as HomeKit sensors. This data isn't available through the official Withings API, so this plugin authenticates the same way the Health Mate web app does. See the README for how to capture the config values below via browser DevTools.

airQualityInferiorMaxPpm.title: Inferior below (ppm)
airQualityInferiorMaxPpm.description: Anything above is reported as Poor.

trustCookieName.title: Trust Cookie Name
trustCookieName.description: The cookie named 2fa_token_<long hex hash> under account.withings.com — copy its full name here

trustCookieValue.title: Trust Cookie Value
trustCookieValue.description: The value of that same 2fa_token_<hash> cookie

publishToMqtt.title: Publish to MQTT
publishToMqtt.description: Publish sensor data to configured MQTT broker. Topic name: "withingsenv/ws-50"

mqttRetain.title: Retain
mqttRetain.description: Publish messages with the MQTT retain flag set, so new subscribers immediately get the last known reading.

noResponseAfterMissedPolls.title: No Response After Missed Polls
noResponseAfterMissedPolls.description: Consecutive failed polls to tolerate before the Home app shows "No Response".

staleDataWarningThresholdHours.title: Stale Data Warning Threshold (hours)
staleDataWarningThresholdHours.description: If the newest CO2/temperature reading from the scale itself is older than this many hours, log a warning, show "No Response" in the Home app, and send a notification.

ntfyTopic.title: ntfy.sh Notification Topic
ntfyTopic.description: If set, sends a push notification via ntfy.sh the first time a poll fails.
